deadline.value: No fixed deadline: applications are accepted until all vacancies are filled. In the last cycle the first Particle Physics and Astronomy cohort was interviewed in February (2026); the page has not yet been updated for 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: We accept applications until all available vacancies are filled. | The first cohort of Particle Physics and Astronomy candidates will be invited for interview which are to be scheduled in February 2026.

app_fee.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

toefl_min.value: All research degrees: TOEFL iBT 88 overall with Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20 and Writing 26. IELTS 6.5 overall with Writing 7.0 and no other subscore below 5.5. Test certificates must be issued no more than 2 years before the start.
toefl_min.quote: All Postgraduate Research degrees (i.e. PhD and Masters by Research) require: | TOEFL iBT: 88 overall, with Reading 18 Listening 17 Speaking 20 Writing 26. | IELTS: 6.5 overall. Writing 7.0. No other subscore lower than 5.5.

english_waiver.value: Two India-specific exemptions. (1) Class 12 English of at least 80% for research degrees, valid for 5 years. (2) A Bachelor's or Master's from a listed Indian university, accepted as medium-of-instruction (MOI) evidence for 3 years after the degree ends. The list includes Anna, Ashoka, IISc Bangalore, IIT Bombay/Delhi/Kanpur/Kharagpur/Madras, Calcutta, Delhi, Kerala, Mumbai, SRM, Amity and others.
english_waiver.quote: Class 12 English Language: 70% for UG (valid for 2 years) and PGT study, and 80% for Research Degrees (both valid for 5 years) | At Royal Holloway, we are able to accept a Bachelor's or Master’s degree completed at the following Indian universities as proof of English competency. | MOI (Medium of Instruction) acceptance is valid for 3 years from the end of your degree.

supervisor.value: Physics asks you to contact the relevant research group contact or pick from its listed projects. Quantum Materials and Technology applicants must email the supervisor named on their application after applying. The University says you 'may need' to secure a supervisor. Physics needs no detailed research proposal and only one application, even for several projects.
supervisor.quote: In this case please contact the relevant group contact on the research group pages or search the list of projects available below. | For Quantum Materials and Technology applicants, when submitting your application through our Applicant Portal, please email the supervisor named on your application. | Physics PhD candidates do not require a detailed research proposal.

also.quote: You may need to secure a supervisor in order to apply for your research project, then apply in our Applicant Portal.

funding.value: About 10 PhD students are accepted each year. Many offers are directly funded or competition funded (UK Research Councils, EC, NPL, CERN, Diamond, Royal Holloway). Overseas students must cover the higher international fee themselves or win one of very few overseas fee waivers.
funding.quote: Typically, we accept 10 students annually onto PhD programmes in our research groups. | Many of our PhD offers are directly funded or competition funded. | We expect overseas candidates to either cover the difference in tuition fees themselves or qualify for an overseas fee waiver from the University. There are very few fee waivers available and competition is very high.

entry_route.value: The University's India page says Indian applicants are considered for MPhil/PhD after a Master's in an appropriate subject with good grades. Physics offers a one-year MSc Physics by Research for BSc-level applicants who want to progress to a doctorate. No Physics-specific PhD degree requirement was found.
entry_route.quote: Students who have successfully completed a Masters degree in an appropriate subject with good grades/GPA will be considered for entry to a Royal Holloway MPhil/PhD programme.

also.quote: MSc Physics by Research may also be taken by those qualified to BSc level who desire to progress to doctoral studies.

notes: Apply through the Applicant Portal with a short statement, CV and transcripts. Funded projects are advertised on FindAPhD. Research areas include condensed matter, particle physics, particle astrophysics, theoretical physics, astronomy, nanotechnology and quantum devices, and accelerator physics.
